subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: What retention and replay contract should OpenClaw use for same-route Gemini `textSignature` and `thoughtSignature` values after a turn is complete?
rationale: Current code intentionally replays valid same-route signatures, and Google’s API contract treats some signatures as required but visible-text signatures as quality-affecting rather than strictly enforced, so automation should not choose the permanent provider semantics alone.

options.title: Bound completed text signatures
options.body: Preserve required tool-call/native-thinking signatures, but drop, cap, or externalize completed visible `textSignature` values before replay to stop session bloat.

options.title: Externalize replay metadata
options.body: Move provider signatures out of visible transcript content and replay only the metadata needed for active same-route continuation.

options.title: Keep current replay pending live proof
options.body: Accept the bloat risk until maintainers obtain stronger live Google proof for a narrower stripping rule.

recommendation.title: Bound completed text signatures
recommendation.body: Preserve required tool-call/native-thinking signatures, but drop, cap, or externalize completed visible `textSignature` values before replay to stop session bloat.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available routing owner for a cross-provider replay contract and release-risk choice.
